name: ARIA
description: A skilled technician working at a community radio station during an emergency. Aria is resourceful, calm under pressure, and focused on restoring communications infrastructure to help coordinate disaster relief efforts.

explicit_evidence.quote: Aria threads a tape reel while NOAH coaxes a signal out of a battered mixer.
Aria flips a switch. The ON AIR sign flickers, then dies again. ARIA: Give me ten minutes and one miracle.
Aria braces the lantern with her boot while Noah clamps the portable antenna to a rusted rail.
Aria smiles for the first time all night and tightens the last bolt.
Aria pins a hand-drawn map beside the console.
ARIA: Put that on repeat between updates.

inferred_traits.rationale: Aria works through the night in harsh conditions on a water tower catwalk to restore emergency communications, showing commitment to helping the community.
Aria maintains focus and composure throughout the emergency setup, only smiling when the antenna successfully receives a distress call, suggesting she channels emotions into action.
Aria confidently handles tape reels, switches, bolts, and radio equipment without hesitation or explanation, indicating prior technical training or experience.
Aria works seamlessly with Noah, June, and Kell, communicating via radio and coordinating tasks without conflict or ego.

dialogue_summary: Aria speaks sparingly but purposefully. She requests time to fix the broadcast system ('Give me ten minutes and one miracle'), responds to Noah's complaint about weather with a quip about boring jobs, confirms radio contact with June during the antenna installation, and makes a practical decision about music programming ('Put that on repeat between updates'). Her dialogue reflects competence and focus on the emergency mission.

relationships.evidence: Aria and Noah work together threading equipment and installing the antenna on the water tower catwalk. They exchange casual banter about weather and jobs.
Aria communicates with June via radio during the antenna installation and receives direction from her. They coordinate on broadcast operations.
Aria works with Kell as part of the emergency radio station team, though they have minimal direct interaction in the provided scenes.
